name: Susanna (supporter)
title: Faithful female disciple and supporter
summary: Susanna was one of the women who followed Jesus and supported him and his disciples with their resources. She had been healed by Jesus of evil spirits or diseases, and showed her gratitude through faithful service and financial support for his ministry.

keyEvents.title: Healed by Jesus
keyEvents.description: Susanna was among the women who had been healed by Jesus of evil spirits and diseases, and who then followed him.

keyEvents.title: Supported Jesus with her resources
keyEvents.description: Together with other women such as Mary Magdalene and Joanna, Susanna used her own resources to provide for Jesus and the twelve disciples during their travels.

keyEvents.title: Followed Jesus on his journeys
keyEvents.description: Susanna was part of the faithful group of women who traveled with Jesus through cities and villages while he preached the gospel about God's kingdom.
